caseNameFull: CONNOR Et Al. v. JOHNSON, GOVERNOR OF MISSISSIPPI, Et Al.
attorneys: Carl Bachlin, Marvin M. Karpatkin, Arthur Kinoy, Melvin L. Wulf, Alvin J. Bronstein and Robert B. McKay for appellants., Joe T. Patterson, Attorney General of Mississippi, and Martin R. McLendon, Assistant Attorney General, for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to affirm is granted and the judgment is affirmed.

Mr. Justice Douglas is of the opinion that probable jurisdiction should be noted and the case set down for argument.
